calculation.expression: -((log(close/close[-20]) - cross_sectional_median(log(close/close[-20]))) / (std(log(close/close[-1]),40)*sqrt(252))) * (1.8 if VIX.pct_change(10)>0 and DXY.pct_change(10)>0 else 1.0), lagged 1 session
calculation.description: Ranks assets for reversal of their 20-session return residual versus the daily cross-sectional median. Volatility scales the residual, while simultaneous 10-session increases in observation-only VIX and DXY amplify the reversal signal. All market data are lagged one completed session before use.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC and ICIR in the reported recent regimes: 2024-2026 IC 0.260626, 2027-2029 0.082340, 2030-2032 0.080796, 2033-2034 0.060203 at 40D; 60D results are positive in each corresponding regime. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
